verification_summary.balance_notes: Race or-us-senate: Merkley 4 bio/6 pos/2 votes, Brock Smith 3/5/0, Henry 3/7/0, Dye 0/0/0; all T1. Voting record: two 2025 Senate roll calls (H.R. 1 reconciliation, S. 5 Laken Riley Act), both verified on senate.gov; they mirror the two votes used for every Oregon House incumbent, so the selection is consistent across incumbents. It is thin, though: both are Republican-majority priorities from 2025, so it shows only party-line opposition. No challenger in this race has a federal record, so there is no in-race comparison. Incumbent=true confirmed by the pamphlet occupation 'U.S. Senator for Oregon'. Website jeffmerkley.com confirmed in pamphlet.
